about: Which run asserted which criterion, when — per published cell, per axis. Generated by scripts/gen-matrix-status.py alongside MATRIX-STATUS.md; evidence links to the asserting run's retained artifact bundle; empty run+date means the axis has no current assertion for that cell. Optional tested_digest/promoted_digest ({arch: digest}) and digest_status bind a result to the image it tested; downgrade_reason (digest-mismatch or digest-unknown) means the result does not count toward composite green.
